Original manga panel artwork. Full-colour webtoon illustration: clean lineart, flat cel shading with soft highlights, a harmonious limited palette.
Scene context (the characters are drawn on separate layers): Rin leaps across the gap between two rooftops, cape snapping behind her. rain streaks catch the lantern light.
Mood: determined.
Setting: Rain market rooftops: Lantern stalls and wet tiles above the night market.
Time of day: night.
Camera: low angle, wide.
Composition: dynamic manga composition with a strong diagonal and a clear focal point; speed lines and motion streaks where the action moves.
Layer: background plate only. Draw the setting and environment with no people, no characters and no figures, filling the whole frame edge to edge on an opaque background; leave natural space where the characters will stand.
Rules: original artwork only; no text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, signatures, watermarks or logos; no panel borders, frames or gutters; one single image, not a comic page; non-explicit, no nudity, no gore.
Avoid: text, letters, words, numbers, speech bubbles, word balloons, captions, sound effect lettering, signature, watermark, logo, panel borders, frames, gutters, multiple panels, comic page layout, nudity, gore, blurry, low quality, deformed hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, people, characters, figures, faces, crowd
